chapter: Family background and the Tulsa music scene
title: Sitting on bandstands with Georgie Lee and the McKinney Cotton Pickers
summary: As a boy he sat on bandstands; Julia Lee took over Georgie Lee's band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: You mentioned that your mother used to put you on the bandstand with the bands, and that was when you first got acquainted. What bands did you share the bandstand with?

Well, Benny Morton and Georgie Lee. Oh, I forgot to tell you. Georgie Lee went out to lunch, as we say today, you know. He would stand out on the corner and just look. So his sister, Julia Lee, took over the band. And eventually it broke up, and then, the next I heard of her, she came out here and formed a small combo to record for Capitol. And that's the last I heard of her.
And the McKinney Cotton Pickers, I sat on their bandstand. And I don't remember who all in it, the personnel, at that time.
